summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American and TASE, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release, notice and proxy statement for its 2026 Annual General Meeting, to be held December 16, 2026 in Tel Aviv. The agenda covers reelection of four directors plus two external directors, approval of external director service terms and option grants, an updated officer/director compensation policy, reappointment of KPMG member Somekh Chaikin as auditors through fiscal 2026, and receipt of FY2025 financials. Record date is November 16, 2026; ordinary majority voting applies, with special disinterested voting for several items. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic action to arbitrage.
